• Windows Torrentio/MKV Auto Sync fix: bundled LGPL FFmpeg extracts digital audio; MPV remains fallback.
• Failure messages now identify audio decoder/Whisper stage without exposing stream URLs.
• Native Windows smoke test decodes actual container audio to Whisper-ready 16 kHz WAV.
• Retains offline Whisper, remembered iOS Speech consent and automatic subtitle rechecks every 5 minutes.
• DRM, unseekable or unsupported streams may still fail. No microphone.
